purpose: Executable ledger for the `topology-dimension-signature` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Topology rows make topology, topology-change, manifoldlikeness, cobordism, compactification, and topology-independence language auditable but cannot promote a route beyond its state-machine ceiling.

topology_rows.topology_object: Topology or manifoldlike support object used by FAMILYC-EW-CODE: spatial slice, boundary/bulk region, compactification, apparatus/catolog/map domain, or simulator target as applicable.
topology_rows.topology_selection_or_sum_rule: Declare whether topology is fixed, summed over, emergent, manifoldlike, order-theoretic, compactified, boundary-induced, survey/apparatus-local, or metadata-only; state whether topology change, cobordism, wormhole/handle, non-Hausdorff, singular, or topology-changing saddle contributions are included or explicitly excluded.
topology_rows.topology_change_or_cobordism_risk: Failure can appear as a fixed-topology result retold as topology-independent support, a topology-changing path integral with unstated causal/singularity costs, a compactification topology mistaken for observed-world selection, or a metadata/package topology mistaken for physical topology.
topology_rows.topology_test: Stress the route by varying allowed topology class, cobordism rule, boundary/slice topology, compactification, causal-order manifoldlikeness, survey window, apparatus region, or benchmark target; freeze topology-independent language unless the route survives the declared variation.
topology_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer background independence, topology independence, topology change, manifold recovery, compactification selection, or global candidate identity from success in one fixed topological sector.
